mostWorthwhile.text: Making the capillary bed was most worthwhile: it showed why the tiny vessels need to be close to cells and what crosses their walls.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the veins felt repetitive after doing the same for the arteries, although it made sense.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the picture to show a nearby muscle squeezing a vein to help blood move past the valves.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave a clear purpose for each pairing.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter because assembling the route helped me connect the different vessel jobs, and I'd be curious to see what comes next.
